items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: I know that [ ] was from Buffalo, New York. And Bill - where he was born I don't know, but he came up 'round Philadelphia, see.

ctx.x: Well, could you compare the solos of the Charlie Miller personnel in 1918, when you're 16 years of age playing with them, with the solo work of Bechet and Armstrong?

No, I wouldn't say that. I tell you why, see. Because actually as we all know Sidney Bechet and - pioneered on the soprano, he was way ahead, and we all know that Louis Armstrong pioneered on the trumpet, way ahead. They wasn't as good, Bill wasn't as good as Louis Armstrong, and I wasn't as good as Sidney Bechet. Well, because I was playing alto, I didn't have the same horn, see.
